description: Angular component for managing map layer settings in a widget configuration, including form handling, validation, and UI interactions.

classes.name: MapLayerRowComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for map layer configuration, with form controls, validation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group and subscribes to form value changes and provider changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on component disabled state.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form with provided value and updates validators.

methods.name: labelPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns translated placeholder label for the layer.

methods.name: editLayer
methods.description: Opens a popover for editing layer settings.

methods.name: onProviderChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the map provider, updating default settings.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts form validators based on provider selection.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model value and propagates change.
